issues.description: The template initializes number_of_qubits_query_register as a float (0.0) which is inconsistent with the intended design: the Kakuro exercise expects an integer number of query qubits (4 for a 2x2 binary grid). QuantumRegister requires an integer size; having a float will cause a runtime/type error and prevents students from instantiating the circuit as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template declaration to use an integer number of query qubits matching the exercise (e.g. set number_of_qubits_query_register = 4). Ensure the auxiliary and classical register counts are integers as well so QuantumRegister and ClassicalRegister are constructed with integer sizes.
